name: show_booking_summary
description: Show the chosen time, the person's name and their email on their screen, so they see them written while you read them back. Call it at the confirmation step, right BEFORE asking whether everything is correct. It books nothing and has no effect on the calendar: it only draws the details on the page. If the person corrects something, call it again with the corrected detail.

optionId.description: The exact id of the option the person chose, as it came from check_availability: opt_1, opt_2 or opt_3.

name.description: The person's full name, exactly as they dictated it.

email.description: The person's email address, lowercase and without spaces. For example: ana.perez@gmail.com
